One account, one app, and six rules every helper follows.
In this exercise you'll set up working books and write your back-office rules.
First, the money: a business-only account and card, or time booked to open one.
Choose QuickBooks Online or Wave, and write two sentences on why.
Have Claude draft a category list with no more than fifteen expense categories, each mapped to Schedule C.
Set up the app, and connect the bank feed if you can.
Copy the six rules into a doc called Back office rules, and name each helper you plan to use.
Check the app's user roles, so a helper can't pay bills or change bank details.
Then turn on two-factor for your bank and your app.
So: is there any path an agent could use to move money?
Pause here and set up your books.
